_about: Poster inspiration for Loom's still images (1080x1350). Each idea maps to the studio's end card: layout (monument, statement, screen) and tone (bg, surface, field). The director picks one per project that suits its direction; the inspiration fetcher adds more over time.

ideas.name: Name wall
ideas.idea: The name fills the bottom of the poster edge to edge, one plain line above it.

ideas.name: Name on a field
ideas.idea: A solid field of colour with the name huge at the foot, nothing else competing.

ideas.name: Quiet name
ideas.idea: Pale surface, the name set calmly, generous empty space above.

ideas.name: Front page
ideas.idea: The one-line promise set as a big headline at the top, the name signed at the foot.

ideas.name: Manifesto card
ideas.idea: The promise as a statement on a coloured field, like a protest placard.

ideas.name: Book cover
ideas.idea: Calm statement on a surface tone, like a literary book cover.

ideas.name: Product hero
ideas.idea: The real product screen framed large, name and line set underneath like a catalogue plate.

ideas.name: Screen on surface
ideas.idea: The product screen on a soft surface tone, like a print mounted on card.

ideas.name: Screen on a field
ideas.idea: The product screen floating on a strong field of colour, name in the field ink.
